title: Mystic Loom Workshop
description: A person sees a hooded figure standing at a wooden table inside a stone room with arched windows. The figure's hands touch a white t-shirt and glowing threads on a large loom that holds a long fabric covered in painted marks and runes while an open book, tools, and a lit candle sit on the table in front.
prompt: a hooded figure stands at a wooden table inside an old stone room with arched windows showing the night sky and aurora. the figure's hands touch a white t-shirt and glowing threads on a large wooden loom that holds a long fabric covered in painted marks and runes. an open book with drawings, metal tools, and a lit candle sit on the table in front. graffiti and painted writing cover the stone walls. dark atmosphere with glowing elements.
